hero.title: Discover the Art
hero.description: From the misty highlands of Asia to your cup, our premium green and red teas offer an authentic journey of flavor. Each leaf is carefully handpicked by master tea farmers and crafted to preserve the natural antioxidants and unique properties. Green tea, rich in anti-inflammatory compounds, supports heart health and boosts metabolism, while red tea delivers a warm, soothing flavor that brings deep relaxation. Every cup of these exquisite teas brings you a moment of tranquility and natural energy.

footer.aboutText: We love tea and have gathered the world's best teas for you.

story.title: The Story of Tea House
story.text1: Tea House was born in the heart of the lush green mountains of northern Iran, where the aroma of fresh tea blends with the morning breeze. With a love for tea culture and a passion for delivering the finest, we began a journey where every cup tells a story of authenticity and quality.
story.text2: From the very first days, we established Tea House with a purpose beyond being just a tea shop. We seek to create an experience that takes you to the lush tea fields of Japan, the plains of India, the mountains of China, and the fragrant gardens of Taiwan with every sip. Each tea leaf is meticulously selected to deliver the most authentic flavors to your cup.
story.text3: At Tea House, we view the art of tea drinking as a ritual of relaxation and mindfulness. Every cup of tea is an opportunity to pause, reflect, and savor life's precious moments. This is what has made us fall in love with the path we have chosen.

mission.title: Vision & Mission
mission.text1: Our vision is to create a world where every cup of tea serves as a bridge to tranquility, health, and a deeper connection with nature. At Tea House, we seek to promote tea drinking as a healthy and authentic lifestyle.
mission.text2: Our mission goes beyond providing quality teas. We are committed to telling a story of sustainability, environmental respect, and support for local farmers with every tea leaf. Our teas not only offer exceptional flavor but also represent our commitment to a better world.
mission.text3: We believe that tea can be more than just a beverage; it can inspire moments of reflection, creativity, and human connection. That is why we pursue the best for you every day with love and dedication.

team.title: Our Team; Tea Lovers
team.text: At the heart of Tea House is a team of true tea enthusiasts. People who accompany you every day with passion and dedication, from tea gardens to your cup. We believe that every tea leaf has a story to tell, and we are proud to be the narrators of those stories. Our team consists of tea experts, flavor designers, and lovers whose goal is to create pure and memorable moments for you.
